claims.text: John Isner's first-round match against Nicolas Mahut at Wimbledon in 2010 was played over three days, from 22 to 24 June.
The Isner-Mahut match was not completed in one or two days, and it did not stretch over five days.
Isner won the final set of the match 70-68.
The match lasted 11 hours 5 minutes of playing time, and its final set more than eight hours.
Play in the Isner-Mahut match was suspended because of fading light on each of the first two days.
